result:
T7 is built. Report:

**Exports shipped**
- `WindowChrome.tsx` — `MAX_LIVE_INSTANCES = 6`, `OpenProject {vault, instanceId, cold, rollup}`, `AddTabResult`, `ChromeApi`, `WindowChrome({initialVault})`, `useChrome()`. Owns: traffic-light inset (`.tauri-overlay`, 86px — no new probe), `<ProjectTabs>`, right cluster = zoom + theme + `StaleServerBanner` + `UpgradeRelaunchBanner` **only**, hoisted `useSidebarCollapse()` passed down, single `<ProjectSwitcher/>`, and `open.filter(p => !p.cold).map(<ProjectInstance …/>)`. `useChrome()` outside a chrome returns a launcher-safe `DETACHED_CHROME` (`addTab` → `openVaultWindow`) rather than throwing, so T9 can call it from the launcher mount.
- `ProjectTabs.tsx` — `ProjectChip`, `ProjectTabs({chips, onActivate, onClose, onAdd, onDetach})`. Chip = dot · name · badge · ×, `+` at the end, right-click → "Open in New Window". Badge omitted at `live === 0`; only `asking` (error) and `working` (accent) take colour, everything else neutral — an unpublished rollup rolls up as `ended`, and mapping that to red would paint every quiet chip.
- `Header.tsx` — −98/+12. Deleted `readVaultLabel` + `header-vault`; moved zoom, theme, and the drag/maximize gestures to chrome. Kept rail toggle (`data-testid="sidebar-collapse"`, used by `e2e/control-panel.spec.ts`), search pill, `SleepDebtTracker`, refresh, `UpdateBadge`.

**Rule 1 (freeze)** — `pointerenter` snapshots the leading gap into `--tabs-lead` and every chip's width inline, then drops the auto margins; a chip closed while frozen leaves a `.project-tab-ghost` of its exact width, so no neighbour slides under the cursor. `pointerleave` clears it and re-centres.
**Rule 2 (fall left)** — the centring is `margin-inline: auto` on the track, which collapses to 0 the instant content exceeds the scroll container, i.e. exactly where centring would start clipping; the `ResizeObserver` publishes `data-overflow` for the edge fades. CSS and flag can't disagree for a frame.

**Checks** — (1) `npx tsc --noEmit` in `dashboard/`: **one** error, `WindowChrome.tsx:7 Cannot find module '../../ProjectInstance'` — T6, concurrent; I imported against its pinned props rather than stubbing its file. (2) `npm run build` **fails on that same single error** (`tsc -b` gates `vite build`); I verified the parts I own instead — `esbuild` compiles `ProjectTabs.css` (8.0kb) and bundles `ProjectTabs.tsx` clean. (3) not verifiable until T6 lands. (4) `localStorage` in WindowChrome = the inherited zoom key only; no tab list anywhere. (5) my delta is exactly the four files — but the tree is **not** clean: another concurrent run is editing `src/lib/automations/*` live, and `npm test`'s 7 failures (automations-cli et al.) reproduce with my Header change stashed, so they are not mine.

**Deviations / hand-offs**
- **No `data-tauri-drag-region`.** `Header.tsx` documents that it injects Tauri's own dblclick→maximize, which fires even with `dragDropEnabled: false` and flickers the window. I used the existing JS gesture on the bar; `startTitleBarDrag` already exempts every `button`, so chips and `+` don't drag and only empty strip space grabs the window — same intent, without the known regression.
- **Title-bar origin rebased in my CSS.** Two bars now sit above a project, and seven surfaces measure "below the title bar" as `--header-height` (agent overlay, `FullscreenOverlay`, `TaskDetailPanel`, sidebar, three boards' inline `calc`). `.window-chrome-body` redefines `--header-height` to `calc(var(--chrome-bar-height) * 2)` and puts `.header` back to one bar — one declaration instead of editing six stylesheets I don't own. Also scoped-overrode `.shell`'s `height: 100vh` and the now-pointless `.tauri-overlay .header` 80px inset.
- **`+` opens the switcher by dispatching the ⌘P keydown it already listens for**, marked `TODO(T9)` — I did not add an open handle to T9's file.
- **`StaleServerBanner` is defined locally in `WindowChrome.tsx`** (it was an unexported local in `App.tsx`). **T6 must delete `App.tsx`'s copy** or both render.
- `addTab` step 2 (focus another window) is a marked `TODO(T20)` — it needs `windowRegistry.ts` from T16, Wave 3.
- Ceiling: evictable **only** when `rollup !== null && rollup.live === 0` **and** not the active chip; `null` is never evictable, so nothing is evictable this wave — intended. Refusals surface in a `.window-chrome-notice` in the bar (kept out of `ProjectTabs`' pinned props).
